hero.h1: Instagram Transcript API for Reels and Videos
hero.subtitle: Turn Reels and Instagram videos into text from your own code. Send a public link and get back what is said, transcribed from the audio — because most Reels have no captions to read.

quickAnswer.question: Is there an official way to get Instagram Reel transcripts?
quickAnswer.answer: No. Instagram's APIs are for managing your own business or creator account and do not return the spoken text of other Reels. TranscriptX does it from a public link, in over 100 languages, with timestamps.

sections.h2: Why Reels Need an Audio Transcript
content: Instagram has no caption track to download. Captions on Reels are usually burned into the video as styled on-screen text, and the post caption underneath rarely matches what is said.
So the only reliable source is the audio. TranscriptX separates the voice from music and trending sounds, then transcribes what is actually spoken.
